name: Flying Fortress

items.name: Space
items.text: 70 feet long, 70 feet wide, 80 feet high

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has eight weapon mounts, with two on each side of the fortress. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 40 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. These weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

text: The ultimate battlefield command center, this massive skyborne castle serves as a platform for launching aerial assaults on land-based and sea-based enemy positions. By hovering over an enemy position, the flying fortress can lay waste to enemies who lack countering siege weapons by firing down on their frontline defenses.
